paragraphs.source_en: In the first year of Genki, Tokugawa Ieyasu’s eldest son, Nobuyasu, was twelve years old. In his father’s stead, he received the retainers’ New Year greetings at Okazaki Castle. At Okazaki Castle, seated beside Matsudaira Jirōsaburō Nobuyasu was Hiraiwa Shichinosuke Chikayoshi, whom Ieyasu had charged with assisting him. Ieyasu, meanwhile, was building a new castle in the Hikuma plain, and most of his retainers had accompanied him there.
